public.search_experiment_results.definition: SELECT e.id AS experiment_id, e.name, s.variant, count(DISTINCT s.id) AS query_count, avg(s.result_count) AS avg_result_count, sum( CASE WHEN sr.clicked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::double precision / NULLIF(count(sr.id)::double precision, 0::double precision) AS ctr FROM search_experiments e JOIN search_sessions s ON s.variant = e.id OR s.variant = e.name LEFT JOIN search_session_results sr ON sr.session_id = s.id GROUP BY e.id, e.name, s.variant
public.search_experiment_results.name: search_experiment_results

public.admin_stats.definition: SELECT date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at) AS hour, count(*) AS runs_count, sum(pages_total) AS pages_total, avg(output_cost_cents + input_cost_cents) AS avg_cost_cents FROM workspace_runs GROUP BY (date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at))
public.admin_stats.name: admin_stats
